fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant reported that a shop near Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex in Tiruppur was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2025-11-17, while the incident was placed on 2025-11-11 at about 15:25. The complaint was lodged by Malathi Kumari (9000000092). A further person, Mathan Raman, an intermediary, using the number 9000000187, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Chithra Kannan, associated with the number 9000000146, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Premises allegedly occupied after the lease period ended.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, suspect, afternoon, shopping complex, documents, associate, mobile number
